text.zh: 表面上是单文件 Windows 程序：双击、浏览器打开本地控制台、四步完成环境。本质上是面向 Windows 环境的 Agent Runtime——模型负责决策，Runtime 负责边界，Verification 负责结论，三者分开。
text.en: On the surface, a single-file Windows program: double-click, a local console opens, four steps to a ready environment. Underneath it is an Agent Runtime for Windows — the model decides, the Runtime enforces boundaries, Verification draws conclusions.

text.zh: Observe → Reason → Act → Verify。第四步不是"模型想起来才做"的收尾，而是和前三步同等地位的一环：执行之后由验证器用端口、进程、HTTP、备份内容与链端共识去判断到底成没成。
text.en: Observe → Reason → Act → Verify. The fourth step is not an afterthought the model may skip — it carries the same weight as the first three. After acting, verifiers use ports, processes, HTTP, backup contents and chain consensus to decide whether it actually worked.

text.zh:
推理灵活、执行受控：模型可自由决定调用顺序，但所有副作用都经过已注册的工具集，没有"执行任意命令"
权限由系统裁定：工具返回成功只代表命令发出去了，能不能说"已完成"由验证器的客观结论决定
经验只影响决策：记忆改变"先查什么、要不要原样重试"，不改变任何操作的授权档位
计划、动作、证据、复验结论、人工确认全部进轨迹与审计；跨会话仍能回答"上次那件事是怎么处理的"。
text.en:
Flexible reasoning, controlled execution: the model may reorder calls freely, but every side effect goes through a registered tool set; there is no arbitrary command execution
The system decides permission: a tool returning success only means the command was sent; saying “done” is the verifier’s objective conclusion
Experience only affects decisions: memory changes what to check first and whether to retry as-is, never an operation’s permission tier
Plans, actions, evidence, verification results and manual confirmations all go into traces and audit. Across sessions you can still answer how a past issue was handled.

text.zh: 命令返回 0、进程派生成功、备份文件生成、端口有人监听、区块高度有变化——这些都是证据，不是结论。EnvKit 把"是否完成"的判定权从模型手里拿走。
text.en: Exit code 0, a spawned process, a generated backup, a listening port or a changing block height are evidence, not conclusions. EnvKit takes the right to declare completion away from the model.

text.zh:
命令返回 0 · 服务可用 · 可能端口没绑上、进程随后退出
进程已派生 · 服务健康 · 可能绑错端口、被别的进程占住
备份文件已生成 · 能还原 · 可能缺触发器、校验和对不上、导出被截断
区块高度静止 · 链卡死了 · PBFT 空块只共识不落盘，判活要看共识视图
text.en:
Exit code 0 · Service is usable · Port may not be bound; process may exit afterwards
Process spawned · Service is healthy · May bind the wrong port or be occupied
Backup file exists · Restorable · May miss triggers, mismatch checksums or be truncated
Static block height · Chain is stuck · PBFT empty blocks reach consensus without storage; check the consensus view

text.zh:
Contract OpResult · 失败被外层吞掉后，模型只能硬编码"已启动"
Verification 验证器 · "命令成功"被误报成"环境已恢复"
Policy 四档权限 · "什么算危险"散落多处，换个入口就能绕过
Trace 任务轨迹 · 失败无法归因，经验退化成凭空总结
Memory 作用域记忆 · 把别的项目的经验套到当前项目
验证不过显示「已执行，未验证」；只有客观证据通过，才显示「已完成」。
text.en:
Contract OpResult · Failures swallowed upstream forced the model to hard-code “started”
Verification · “Command succeeded” misreported as “environment restored”
Policy tiers · “What is dangerous” was scattered; another entry point bypassed it
Trace · Failures could not be attributed; experience degenerated into guesswork
Memory · Experience from another project applied to the current one
Failed verification shows “executed, unverified”; only passing objective evidence shows “completed”.

text.zh: 第一次打开时，如果前后端目录还是空的，EnvKit 会先弹出「项目接入向导」：只需要选目录，剩下的检查交给它。保存以后再按左侧四步走。已经填过目录的用户不会自动弹，随时可以点顶栏「接入项目」重走一遍。
text.en: On first launch, if the front/back-end folders are empty, EnvKit opens the project setup wizard first: choose folders, and it does the checks. After saving, follow the four steps on the left. Users with folders already set do not get it automatically, but can reopen it from “Set up project” in the top bar.

text.zh:
接入项目：选前端 / 后端目录，EnvKit 自动识别项目类型、启动方式、端口和数据库配置。检查是只读的，不会启动服务。
环境安装：检测 Go / Node.js / MySQL，Java 后端还会检查 JDK 和 Maven。下载走国内镜像，校验 SHA256，失败会自动换源。
程序配置：用向导保存后一般不用再填；需要调整目录、数据库或启动方式时再来这一页。
链端校验：填 SSH 与链目录，检查节点端口、进程与共识视图。
程序启动：先后端再前端；日志按来源分栏。EnvKit 正常从桌面启动时，退出会带走子进程；从 IDE / 终端启动时可能带不走，见「停止到底停没停」。
text.en:
Set up the project: choose the front/back-end folders and EnvKit works out the project type, start command, ports and database settings. The check is read-only and starts nothing.
Environment: check Go / Node.js / MySQL; Java backends also check JDK and Maven. Downloads use domestic mirrors, SHA256 checks and automatic retries.
Configuration: usually nothing to fill after the wizard; come back here only to adjust folders, the database or the start command.
Chain: set SSH and chain folders; check the node port, processes and consensus view.
Start: backend first, then frontend. Logs are split by source. When EnvKit runs normally from the desktop, exiting reaps its children; when launched from an IDE or terminal it may not — see “Did stop really stop?”.

text.zh:
控制台默认 http://127.0.0.1:18765/ ，端口冲突时自动顺延。那个黑色命令行窗口就是服务本体：关掉它网页就打不开。要从托盘菜单选「隐藏窗口到托盘」，不是结束进程。新版本已把控制台换成纸白底的浅色主题。
第一次接入的细节见下一节「项目接入向导」；快捷键、地址栏深链见「快捷键与深链」。
text.en:
The console defaults to http://127.0.0.1:18765/ and shifts ports on conflict. The console window IS the service: closing it kills the page. Use the tray menu to hide it, not to end the process. New builds use a light paper-coloured theme.
For first-time setup details see “Project setup wizard”; for shortcuts and URL deep links see “Shortcuts & deep links”.

text.zh: 向导只做三件事：选目录、只读检查、保存配置。它不会启动服务、不会安装依赖、不会结束进程。你要做的只是告诉它前后端在哪里。
text.en: The wizard does three things: choose folders, run a read-only check, save the result. It does not start services, install dependencies or end processes. You only tell it where the front and back ends are.

text.zh:
第一次打开，且前后端目录都为空：首屏引导结束后自动弹出。
已经填过目录：不再自动弹，点顶栏「接入项目」可以随时重走。
点「稍后再说」：这次先跳过，之后不会再反复弹；需要时从顶栏进入。
再次进入时，已经保存的目录会预先填好，方便只改其中一项。
text.en:
First launch with both folders empty: it opens after the welcome tour.
Folders already set: it does not auto-open; use “Set up project” in the top bar whenever needed.
“Later” skips it for now and stops repeated pop-ups; reopen it from the top bar when ready.
On reopen, saved folders are pre-filled so you can change just one item.

text.zh:
选目录：前端、后端至少填一个，只填后端也可以。点「选择」打开本机目录，不会走 SSH。
开始检查：进度条会显示正在看哪一项，检查很快完成时画面会放慢，方便看清步骤。
看结果并保存：确认前后端识别结果，需要的话顺便测试数据库、建库或导入 SQL。
text.en:
Choose folders: fill at least one; backend-only is fine. “Choose” opens a local folder picker, not SSH.
Run the check: the progress panel shows which item is being read; fast checks are slowed down briefly so the steps stay readable.
Review and save: confirm the front/back-end results, and optionally test the database, create it or import SQL.

text.zh:
前端目录 · 目录是否存在；package.json、vite.config、next.config 等特征文件 · 项目类型、启动脚本、端口线索
前端类型 · Vite / Next.js / Nuxt / Vue CLI / React CRA / Node 脚本 · 用哪套方式启动
后端目录 · pom.xml、go.mod、main.go、入口文件 · 构建系统、启动命令、端口
后端类型 · Spring Boot / Maven / Go · 例如 mvn spring-boot:run 或 go run
数据库配置 · application*.yml、.env、config、docker-compose 等 · host、库名、账号、密码来源
工具链 · Node、Go、JDK、Maven 是否可用 · 缺什么会提前提示
text.en:
Frontend folder · Folder exists; package.json, vite.config, next.config and similar markers · Project type, start script and port hints
Frontend type · Vite / Next.js / Nuxt / Vue CLI / React CRA / Node script · Which start method fits
Backend folder · pom.xml, go.mod, main.go and entry files · Build system, start command and port
Backend type · Spring Boot / Maven / Go · For example mvn spring-boot:run or go run
Database settings · application*.yml, .env, config, docker-compose and similar files · Host, database name, user and where the password came from
Toolchain · Whether Node, Go, JDK and Maven are usable · Missing tools are flagged before you start

text.zh:
前后端卡片：先看「识别为」对不对，再看启动方式和端口。
端口后面的来源和百分比表示“有多确定”，不是硬性结论；没识别到端口也不影响保存，启动时会继续探测。
黄色「留意」不是失败：例如没找到 package.json、数据库密码没解析、工具没装。能保存，但启动前最好先处理。
如果目录选错了，返回第一步改；不需要关闭整个向导。
text.en:
Front/back cards: check the detected type first, then the start command and port.
The source and percentage after a port show how confident the guess is, not a final answer. No port hint does not block saving; start-up will keep probing.
A yellow warning is not a failure: for example no package.json, no database password or a missing tool. You can still save, but fix it before starting if possible.
If a folder is wrong, go back to step one; no need to close the whole wizard.

heading.zh: 数据库：先测试，再建库，再导入

text.zh:
先勾选一组数据库候选，点「测试连接」。能看到 MySQL 版本、库是否存在，说明账号和网络没问题。
库不存在时，可以勾选「保存后建库」，EnvKit 会创建空库。
需要初始化表结构时，再勾选「建库后导入 SQL」。SQL 文件从项目目录里查找，默认优先 schema.sql。
导入成功后会记住这个 SQL 文件，下次在程序配置里还能看到。
测试连接、列库表、建库和只读查询用 EnvKit 内置的 MySQL 驱动，不需要单独装 mysql.exe；导入 SQL、备份和恢复仍调用 MySQL 自带的 mysql / mysqldump。
导入 SQL 会直接执行，不会自动备份。已有数据的库上导入，可能重复建表或覆盖数据；只选你确认过的初始化脚本。同一个文件重复执行时会有历史提示，但仍会继续。
text.en:
Select a database candidate and press “Test connection”. Seeing the MySQL version and whether the database exists means the account and network are fine.
If the database is missing, tick “Create after saving” and EnvKit creates an empty database.
To create tables too, tick “Import SQL after creating”. SQL files are found inside the project, with schema.sql preferred.
After a successful import, the SQL file is remembered and shown later in Configuration.
Connection tests, table listing, database creation and read-only queries use EnvKit’s built-in MySQL driver, so a separate mysql.exe is not required. SQL import, backup and restore still use MySQL’s own mysql / mysqldump.
Importing SQL runs it directly and does not create a backup. On a database that already has data it may duplicate tables or overwrite data; only use an init script you trust. Running the same file again shows a history warning but still proceeds.

text.zh:
保存只写前后端目录；勾选数据库时才一起写 host、端口、库名、账号和密码。
密码只在本机加密保存，不出现在检查结果里，也不会写进日志。
保存后项目画像立即刷新，程序启动页可以直接用新的目录、启动命令和端口。
想改启动脚本、备份目录这类细节，去「程序配置」；想重新识别项目，点顶栏「接入项目」。
检查过程是只读的。向导不会启动前后端、不会 npm install、不会 go mod tidy，也不会杀任何进程；这些动作仍然在程序配置和程序启动页发生。
text.en:
Saving writes the folders; database host, port, name, user and password are written only when that option is ticked.
Passwords are encrypted on this machine only; they never appear in check results or logs.
The project profile refreshes immediately, so the Start page can use the new folders, commands and ports.
To change the start script or backup folder, use Configuration; to re-detect the project, use “Set up project” in the top bar.
The check is read-only. The wizard does not start services, run npm install or go mod tidy, or kill any process; those actions stay on the Configuration and Start pages.

text.zh: 控制台和文档页共用同一套键盘习惯：命令面板一键唤起，页面用地址栏锚点直达，不用在长列表里翻。
text.en: The console and the docs share one keyboard habit: the command palette is one keystroke away, and pages are reachable through URL anchors instead of long lists.

text.zh:
Ctrl+K · 搜索并跳转页面、按钮、章节 · 控制台 / 文档
/ · 聚焦文档搜索框 · 文档页
Esc · 退出搜索框 / 关闭命令面板 · 控制台 / 文档
text.en:
Ctrl+K · Search and jump to pages, buttons and sections · Console / docs
/ · Focus the docs search box · Docs
Esc · Leave search / close the palette · Console / docs

text.zh:
/docs · 桌面版服务端文档站（新标签，可离线、可打印）
/#tour · 回到控制台并重播界面导览（仅桌面版）
/#config、#chain、#audit · 直达对应功能页（仅桌面版）
/docs#doc-chain · 直达文档某一节（桌面版 / 在线版通用）
命令面板索引的是页面上真实存在的导航与按钮，不索引 AI 工具；写操作仍走各自的确认闸门。
text.en:
/docs · Docs served by the desktop app in a new tab; offline and printable
/#tour · Back to the console and replay the tour (desktop only)
/#config, #chain, #audit · Straight to the matching page (desktop only)
/docs#doc-chain · Open a specific section (desktop and online)
The palette indexes real navigation and buttons on the page, not AI tools; write operations still pass their own confirmation gates.

text.zh: 从 Releases 下载最新的 Windows x64 压缩包，解压后运行 安装.bat（复制到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit 并建桌面快捷方式），或直接双击 EnvKit.exe —— 单文件、免安装。想自己编译就往下看源码构建。
text.en: Download the latest Windows x64 archive from Releases and run 安装.bat to copy it into %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit with a desktop shortcut, or just double-click EnvKit.exe — one file, no installer. To compile it yourself, build from source below.

text.zh:
操作系统 · Windows 10 / 11 x64
MySQL 绿色版 · 需要 VC++ 2019 Redistributable (x64)
管理员权限 · 注册 / 启动 MySQL 服务时需要；其余功能不需要
Java 后端 · JDK（版本按 pom.xml 要求）+ Maven；向导会检查，缺了会提前提示，但检查阶段不会替你安装
网络 · 首次安装组件约 180 MB，可配下载代理
如果走的是桌面快捷方式，注意它可能指向 %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit 里的旧副本。更新后请重新运行 安装.bat，或直接打开仓库根的 EnvKit.exe。
text.en:
OS · Windows 10 / 11 x64
Portable MySQL · Requires VC++ 2019 Redistributable (x64)
Administrator · Only for registering / starting the MySQL service
Java backend · JDK (version from pom.xml) + Maven; the wizard checks them and flags missing tools, but does not install them during the check
Network · About 180 MB on first component install; proxy configurable
A desktop shortcut may still point at an old copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit. After an update, rerun 安装.bat or open the EnvKit.exe at the repository root.

text.zh:
git clone https://github.com/hrui83771-gif/EnvKit.git
cd EnvKit
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o EnvKit.exe .
需要 Go 1.26 或更高；图标与版本信息已通过 resource.syso 编进 exe。构建产物就是仓库根的 EnvKit.exe，单文件自带全部前端资源。前端源码按文件拆在 web/src/，改完必须按下面的顺序重建——只跑 web_build.py 不重建 exe，界面不会变，这是最常见的「改了没生效」。
python tools/web_build.py
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o EnvKit.exe .
直接改 web/index.html 会在下次构建时被覆盖；web_build.py --check 只校验产物一致性，不会重新嵌入。
text.en:
git clone https://github.com/hrui83771-gif/EnvKit.git
cd EnvKit
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o EnvKit.exe .
Requires Go 1.26 or newer. The icon and version info are compiled in via resource.syso. The result is the single-file EnvKit.exe at the repository root with all front-end assets embedded. Front-end sources live in web/src/; rebuild in this order — running only web_build.py will not change the exe, the most common cause of “nothing changed”.
python tools/web_build.py
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o EnvKit.exe .
Editing web/index.html directly is overwritten on the next build; web_build.py --check only verifies consistency, it does not re-embed.

text.zh:
检测会同时读版本号与安装位置，不只看命令能不能跑。前端需要 Node.js，Go 后端需要 Go，Java 后端还需要符合 pom.xml 要求的 JDK 和 Maven；向导会一并检查。安装走国内镜像，下载后校验 SHA256，失败自动换源重试。
演练安装 · 先列出会下载什么、装到哪里，再决定是否真装
SHA256 校验 · 下载完比对摘要，不对就换源重试
版本管理 · 组件版本集中管理，可单独升级，不必重装整套
镜像配置 · GOPROXY 与 npm registry 自动指向可达的国内源
注册或启动 MySQL 服务需要管理员权限：右键 EnvKit.exe「以管理员身份运行」只在这一步需要，其余功能照常用。
text.en:
Detection reads both version and install path, not just whether a command runs. Front ends need Node.js, Go backends need Go, and Java backends also need a JDK matching pom.xml plus Maven; the wizard checks all of them. Installs use domestic mirrors, verify SHA256, and retry from another source on failure.
Dry run · See what would be downloaded and installed before committing
SHA256 check · Compare hashes after download; retry from another source on mismatch
Version manager · Central version list; upgrade a single component without reinstalling everything
Mirrors · GOPROXY and npm registry point at reachable domestic mirrors
Registering or starting the MySQL service needs administrator rights: run EnvKit.exe as administrator only for that step; everything else works normally.

text.zh: EnvKit 是单文件程序，没有安装器：所谓升级就是把新 exe 覆盖旧的。麻烦不在覆盖本身，而在"哪个副本在运行、配置会不会被冲掉、想退回上一版怎么办"这三件事。
text.en: EnvKit is a single-file program with no installer: upgrading simply overwrites the old exe with a new one. The trouble is not the copy itself, but three questions — which copy is running, whether config survives, and how to go back.

text.zh:
先退出正在运行的实例：托盘图标右键退出，或关闭所有 EnvKit 窗口。exe 被占用时复制会失败，这是升级没生效的头号原因。
从 Releases 下载新压缩包，解压后运行 安装.bat：它把新 exe 复制到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit 并更新桌面快捷方式。
确认打开的是新版本：页头版本号应变化；若还是旧的，多半是快捷方式指向了另一份副本，见下条。
配置不用重新填：config.json 在 exe 同目录，安装脚本只覆盖 exe 和使用说明，不会碰它。
从源码自己编译时顺序是 web_build.py → go build，且 go build 前要先退出运行中的实例；只跑其中一步会让人以为"改了没生效"。见「从源码构建」。
text.en:
Quit the running instance first: right-click the tray icon to exit, or close all EnvKit windows. A locked exe makes the copy fail — the number one cause of an upgrade that “did not take”.
Download the new archive from Releases, unpack and run 安装.bat: it copies the new exe into %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit and refreshes the desktop shortcut.
Confirm you are on the new build: the header version should change. If it does not, the shortcut probably points at another copy — see below.
No need to re-enter settings: config.json sits next to the exe, and the install script only overwrites the exe and readme — it leaves config alone.
When building from source, run web_build.py then go build, and quit the running instance before go build. Doing only one step looks like “nothing changed”. See Build from source.

heading.en: Shortcut points at an old copy

text.zh:
升级后版本号没变 · 快捷方式指向 %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit 的旧 exe · 重跑 安装.bat，或直接打开仓库根的 EnvKit.exe
两份 exe 版本不一致 · 仓库根一份、%LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit 一份，各自更新 · 认准常用那份；两份都在时以快捷方式 TargetPath 为准
text.en:
Version unchanged after upgrade · Shortcut points at the old exe in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit · Rerun 安装.bat, or open the repo-root EnvKit.exe directly
Two exes with different versions · One at repo root, one in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit, updated separately · Stick to one; when both exist, trust the shortcut’s TargetPath

text.zh:
程序本身没有回滚功能，但单文件让回滚很简单：升级前把当前 exe 另存一份（如 EnvKit-v3.7.2.exe），要退回时用它覆盖回去即可。config.json 建议一并备份——如果新版改了配置结构，回滚后旧 exe 未必能读懂新配置。
:: back up the current exe before upgrading
:: (replace v3.7.2 with your actual version)
copy /Y EnvKit.exe EnvKit-v3.7.2.exe
:: to roll back, overwrite with the backup
copy /Y EnvKit-v3.7.2.exe EnvKit.exe
上面代码块里的文件名只是占位示例，按你当前的实际版本改名；配置备份用「程序配置」页的导出功能，导出的文件可脱敏。
text.en:
There is no built-in rollback, but a single file makes it easy: before upgrading, save a copy of the current exe (e.g. EnvKit-v3.7.2.exe), then overwrite with it to roll back. Back up config.json too — if a new version changed its schema, the old exe may not read the newer config.
:: back up the current exe before upgrading
:: (replace v3.7.2 with your actual version)
copy /Y EnvKit.exe EnvKit-v3.7.2.exe
:: to roll back, overwrite with the backup
copy /Y EnvKit-v3.7.2.exe EnvKit.exe
The filename in the sample is a placeholder — rename it to your actual version. Back up config via the export action on the Configuration page; the export can be redacted.

text.zh:
发布包里带一个 卸载.bat：它结束 EnvKit 进程，删除 %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit 里的 exe、使用说明和 config.json，并移除桌面快捷方式。想保留配置就先把 config.json 复制出去再运行。
卸载脚本不会自动删除以下内容，需要按需手动清理：C:\EnvKit\tools 组件目录、已注册的 MySQL 服务与数据库数据、PATH 里的环境变量、项目里的 backups 备份目录，以及 exe 同目录的 envkit-*.log 日志。它也不会写注册表的卸载项，所以"添加/删除程序"里看不到 EnvKit 是正常的。
text.en:
The release archive ships a 卸载.bat: it stops EnvKit, deletes the exe, readme and config.json in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnvKit, and removes the desktop shortcut. Copy config.json out first if you want to keep it.
The uninstall script does not remove these — clean them up manually as needed: the C:\EnvKit\tools component directory, the registered MySQL service and its data, PATH entries, the backups directory in your project, and the envkit-*.log files next to the exe. It also writes no registry uninstall entry, so EnvKit not appearing in “Add / Remove Programs” is expected.

text.zh: config.json 放在 exe 同目录，覆盖内置默认值；config.dist.json 是干净模板。项目接入向导保存的结果也会写到这里。数据库连接检测、建库建表、一键备份 / 还原（失败自动重试）、前端 npm install / 后端 go mod tidy、配置导入导出（可脱敏分享）、环境诊断报告都在这一页。
text.en: config.json lives next to the exe and overrides built-in defaults; config.dist.json is a clean template. Results saved by the project setup wizard also land here. Database checks, schema creation, backup / restore with retries, npm install / go mod tidy, redacted config export / import and diagnostic reports all live here.

text.zh:
改设置页里的开关与阈值：保存后即时生效，写回 config.json 并自动留上一版备份。
改端口、目录这类连接参数：先在「程序配置」改数据库连接并测试，再改项目目录，最后重启前后端让进程读到新值。
直接编辑 config.json：改完要重启 EnvKit；导出配置默认脱敏，分享前确认没带上密钥。
text.en:
Change switches and thresholds in Settings: they take effect immediately, are written back to config.json and a previous-version backup is kept.
For ports and paths: change and test the database connection in Configuration, then project paths, then restart front and back end so processes pick up the new values.
Editing config.json directly requires an EnvKit restart. Exported configs are redacted by default — check no key slipped in before sharing.

text.zh:
config.json                 当前配置
config.dist.json           干净模板
audit-YYYYMMDD.jsonl       操作审计（保留 30 天）
envkit-YYYYMMDD.log        运行日志（按日轮转）
missions.json / playbooks.json / memories.json   行动 / 预案 / 记忆
API Key 与数据库密码经 Windows DPAPI 加密，只在本机可解密。导出的配置默认脱敏，分享前再确认一次没有带上密钥。
text.en:
config.json                 active config
config.dist.json           clean template
audit-YYYYMMDD.jsonl       operation audit (kept 30 days)
envkit-YYYYMMDD.log        daily rotating log
missions.json / playbooks.json / memories.json   actions / playbooks / memory
API keys and database passwords are encrypted with Windows DPAPI and decrypt only on this machine. Exported configs are redacted by default — check again before sharing.

text.zh: 4.0 把“装环境”推进为“按契约检查 → 可控修复 → 留快照回滚”。契约文件是项目根目录的 envkit.yaml，只描述期望状态，不保存密码；入口在设置页的「高级 / 环境契约与扩展」，默认折叠，不占基础设置版面。
text.en: 4.0 turns “set up an environment” into “check against a contract → repair within limits → keep a snapshot for rollback”. The contract is envkit.yaml in the project root; it describes the expected state and stores no passwords. The entry lives under “Advanced / contract and extensions” in Settings, collapsed by default.

text.zh:
项目接入向导结果页勾选「同时生成项目级环境契约」会自动写入一份；也可以手写。契约里只允许声明工具版本、本地服务、端口探针、数据库与 schema、密钥引用，不接受任意 shell 命令。
version: 1
project:
  name: tcm-inventory
  root: .
tools:
  java: ">=17"
services:
  - id: web
    label: 前端
    adapter: local
    risk_tier: low
    dir: web
    probe:
      kind: port
      port: 5173
  - id: backend
    label: 后端
    adapter: local
    risk_tier: low
    dir: server
    probe:
      kind: port
      port: 8080
database:
  engine: mysql
  host: localhost
  port: 3306
  name: tcm_inventory
  user: root
  schema: schema.sql
  required_tables:
    - sys_user
secrets:
  mysql_password: local:mysql_password
密码不进契约：secrets 只写引用名，真实密码仍由本机 DPAPI 或环境变量提供。数据库表清单没声明时 Doctor 报 undeclared，不猜。
text.en:
Tick “also generate a project contract” on the setup wizard result page to write one automatically, or write it by hand. The contract may declare tool versions, local services, port probes, the database and schema, and secret references — never arbitrary shell commands.
version: 1
project:
  name: tcm-inventory
  root: .
tools:
  java: ">=17"
services:
  - id: web
    label: 前端
    adapter: local
    risk_tier: low
    dir: web
    probe:
      kind: port
      port: 5173
  - id: backend
    label: 后端
    adapter: local
    risk_tier: low
    dir: server
    probe:
      kind: port
      port: 8080
database:
  engine: mysql
  host: localhost
  port: 3306
  name: tcm_inventory
  user: root
  schema: schema.sql
  required_tables:
    - sys_user
secrets:
  mysql_password: local:mysql_password
Passwords stay out of the contract: secrets only name a reference; the real value still comes from local DPAPI or environment variables. If the table list is not declared, Doctor reports undeclared instead of guessing.

text.zh:
readonly（默认） · 读取契约、跑 Doctor、生成修复计划 · 执行 Apply；请求会被 409 拦下，不建快照、不启动服务
enforce · 执行计划里勾选的白名单动作，执行前自动快照 · 执行计划外动作、导入 schema 免确认、自动切换工具链版本
切换到 enforce 需要二次确认；确认后模式才会变。切回 readonly 随时可以，已生成的快照仍保留。
text.en:
readonly (default) · Read the contract, run Doctor, generate a repair plan · Run Apply; the request is blocked with 409, with no snapshot and no service start
enforce · Run the selected whitelisted actions, snapshotting first · Run anything outside the plan, import schema without confirmation, or switch toolchain versions
Switching to enforce requires a second confirmation, and only then does the mode change. Switching back to readonly is always allowed; existing snapshots stay.

text.zh:
展开「高级 / 环境契约与扩展」，在「环境契约 Doctor」点「运行诊断」。Doctor 只读：不启动、不停止、不修复。
看汇总：ok / drift / unknown / undeclared。drift 才是可执行差异；远程链端保持 unknown，未声明的表清单保持 undeclared。
点「生成修复计划」。计划只从 Doctor 偏差里生成白名单动作：建缺失的库、导入契约 schema、启动 web/backend。
勾选要执行的动作。导入 schema 属于 confirm 档，未确认会被 428 拦下；建库和启动服务属于 safe 档。
需要真正写入时，点「启用执行（enforce）」并确认。执行前会自动拍快照，记录快照 ID、是否包含数据库和回滚提示。
点「执行选中项」。任一动作失败就停止，后面的动作不执行，结果里标记「前序动作失败，未执行」。
需要撤销时，从快照列表恢复。恢复前会先备份当前配置/数据库，恢复本身还要再确认一次。
text.en:
Open “Advanced / contract and extensions” and press “Run diagnosis” under “Contract Doctor”. Doctor is read-only: it starts, stops and repairs nothing.
Read the summary: ok / drift / unknown / undeclared. Only drift is actionable; remote chain ends stay unknown, and undeclared table lists stay undeclared.
Press “Generate repair plan”. The plan only draws whitelisted actions from Doctor drift: create a missing database, import the contract schema, start web/backend.
Tick the actions to run. Schema import is a confirm-tier action and is blocked with 428 until confirmed; database creation and service start are safe.
To allow writes, press “Enable enforce” and confirm. A snapshot is taken before execution, recording its ID, whether it includes the database, and the rollback note.
Press “Run selected”. The first failure stops the transaction; later actions are not run and are marked “skipped after an earlier failure”.
To undo, restore from the snapshot list. The current config/database is backed up first, and the restore itself asks for confirmation again.

text.zh:
配置与服务/端口现场：恢复到快照时保存的本机配置和现场记录。
已存在的数据库：快照含数据库时，恢复会先清空当前库的表/视图，再导入快照 dump，所以快照之后新增的表也会被删除。
本次新建的库：建库动作不在快照回滚范围内，回滚不会删除这个新库；提示里会明确写明。
项目里的 envkit.yaml：恢复不覆盖它，只把快照副本放到旁边供对照。
快照失败 = 不执行；恢复失败或表数量不一致时，会尝试用恢复前刚生成的备份回填，并在消息里标记“已回滚到恢复前备份”。
text.en:
Config and service/port site: restored to what was recorded when the snapshot was taken.
An existing database: when the snapshot includes it, restore clears current tables/views before importing the dump, so tables added after the snapshot are removed too.
A database created in this transaction: creation is outside snapshot rollback, so rollback does not drop it; the note says so explicitly.
The project envkit.yaml: restore never overwrites it; the snapshot copy is placed beside it for comparison.
A failed snapshot means nothing runs. If restore fails or the table count does not match, EnvKit tries to refill from the backup taken just before restore and says “rolled back to the pre-restore backup”.

heading.en: What it still will not do

text.zh:
工具链只诊断版本是否满足约束，不自动升级、降级或切换。
只自动启动 web / backend 两个本地服务；其他本地服务属于按需扩展，默认关闭。
不执行任意 shell、不克隆整机、不做 Docker Desktop 整机快照，也不替你决定不可逆修复。
MCP、契约 Doctor、环境事务与快照都在「高级」里，默认收起；不用契约时保持 readonly 即可。
text.en:
Toolchains are only diagnosed against the version constraint; no automatic upgrade, downgrade or switch.
Only the local web and backend services are started automatically; other local services are opt-in extensions, off by default.
No arbitrary shell, no whole-machine cloning or Docker Desktop snapshot, and no irreversible repair decided for you.
MCP, Contract Doctor, transactions and snapshots all sit under “Advanced”, collapsed by default; if you do not use contracts, leave it in readonly.

text.zh: 支持 FISCO-BCOS v2 / WeBASE-Front 连通检测、SSH 密码或私钥登录、页面内嵌终端与远程目录浏览；节点异常可一键检测或交给后台守护自动恢复，并触发 Windows 通知。
text.en: Supports FISCO-BCOS v2 / WeBASE-Front connectivity, SSH password or key login, an embedded terminal and remote directory browsing. Recovery can be manual or handled by the background guard with Windows notifications.

text.zh:
程序配置 → 链端配置 · 主机 192.0.2.10 · 端口 22 · 用户 root · 先填这个并点「测试 SSH 连接」，绿了再往下
链端配置 · 密码留空则用私钥 · 私钥填本机路径；首次连接按 TOFU 记主机指纹
链端配置 → 链 · 链主机留空 = 同 SSH 主机；端口 20200 · 链主机与 SSH 不同机时才填
链端配置 → 链 · 链端目录 /opt/fisco/nodes/127.0.0.1 · 点「选择」用远程目录浏览挑，别手输错路径
链端配置 → 链 · 启动脚本 bash start_all.sh · 宕机自愈时 EnvKit 用它在远端拉起节点
链端配置 → WeBASE · W 目录 /opt/webase/webase-front · 脚本 bash start.sh · 端口 5002 · 群组 1 · 只在用 WeBASE-Front 时填
text.en:
Configuration → Chain · Host 192.0.2.10 · port 22 · user root · Fill this and test SSH first; continue only when it passes
Chain config · Leave password empty to use a private key · Key is a local path; first connect records the host fingerprint (TOFU)
Chain config → chain · Chain host empty = same as SSH host; port 20200 · Only fill when the chain host differs from SSH
Chain config → chain · Chain dir /opt/fisco/nodes/127.0.0.1 · Use the remote picker instead of typing a path by hand
Chain config → chain · Start script bash start_all.sh · Used by self-healing to restart the node remotely
Chain config → WeBASE · W dir /opt/webase/webase-front · script bash start.sh · port 5002 · group 1 · Only needed when using WeBASE-Front

text.zh:
填 SSH 主机 / 端口 / 用户与凭据，点「测试 SSH 连接」；状态变绿再继续。
填链端口与目录，用「选择」远程挑目录；需要 WeBASE 再填 W 目录与端口。
点「检测」看四项：节点端口、进程、共识视图推进、WeBASE 地址；成功信号是「检测通过」，不是命令返回 0。
要拉起服务用「启动」菜单分别启动节点与 WeBASE；需要命令行时用「终端」或远程执行命令。
挂机无人值守再打开「后台守护」，间隔默认 60 秒、最小 30；需要弹通知加开 chain_notify。
text.en:
Fill SSH host / port / user and credentials, then test the connection; continue once it turns green.
Fill the chain port and directory, use the picker to choose the remote directory; fill WeBASE fields only if used.
Press Check and inspect four things: node port, process, consensus view progression and WeBASE URL. Success means the check passed, not exit code 0.
Use the Start menu to bring up the node and WeBASE separately; use Terminal or remote exec for commands.
For unattended runs enable the background guard (default 60 s, minimum 30) and chain_notify for desktop alerts.

text.zh:
判活看的是共识视图是否推进，不是区块高度。PBFT 空块只共识不落盘，块高静止是正常态；拿块高判活会把健康链永远判成未恢复。
SSH 指纹变了连接被拒——那是保护不是故障：先核对新指纹再决定是否更新，别直接关校验。
自愈态势页空列表表示尚无守护 / 影子记录，不代表守护没配置；看配置页的守护开关。
「已执行」只说明命令跑了：端口、进程、共识视图、WeBASE 地址四项都拿到证据才算完成。
text.en:
Liveness is judged by consensus view progression, NOT block height. PBFT empty blocks reach consensus without being stored, so a static height is normal; judging by height marks healthy chains as unrecovered.
A rejected SSH connection after a fingerprint change is protection, not breakage: verify the new fingerprint before trusting it, never simply disable the check.
An empty self-healing list means no guard or shadow records yet, not that guarding is off; check the switch on the config page.
“Executed” only means the command ran: completion needs evidence from all four — port, process, consensus view and WeBASE URL.

text.zh: 前后端一键启动（先后端、再前端），访问地址自动解析；日志按来源分栏并清理 ANSI 转义码，支持复制、下载和自动滚动。日志会写到 exe 同目录的 envkit-<日期>.log、envkit-<日期>-web.log 和 envkit-<日期>-backend.log。
text.en: Start backend then frontend with one click; access URLs are resolved automatically. Logs are split by source, stripped of ANSI codes, and support copy, download and auto-scroll. Log files land next to the exe as envkit-<date>.log, envkit-<date>-web.log and envkit-<date>-backend.log.

text.zh:
先在「程序配置」填好前后端目录与数据库连接并测试；目录填的是项目根，不是某个源文件。
到「程序启动」点启动：先后端、再前端，访问地址由端口与入口文件自动解析。
看日志页：按 install / config / start / chain / sys 分栏，已清理 ANSI 转义码，可复制、下载、自动滚动。
验证要用「检测」或 AI 的 verify_environment：看端口、HTTP 握手、进程数，不看启动按钮的反应。
停止后看端口是否真的释放：显示“未完全停止”时先处理残留进程，再重新启动。
text.en:
In Configuration, set and test the front/back-end paths and DB connection first; paths point at project roots, not source files.
On the Start page press start: backend first, then frontend; the access URL is resolved from ports and entry files.
Read the Logs page: split into install / config / start / chain / sys, ANSI codes stripped, with copy, download and auto-scroll.
Verify with Check or the AI verify_environment tool: ports, HTTP handshake and process count — not the start button reaction.
After stopping, check that the port is actually free; if “partly stopped” appears, clear the leftover process before restarting.

heading.en: How the front-end script is chosen

text.zh:
启动页的脚本框留空时，EnvKit 会读 package.json，按 dev → serve → start → watch 的顺序挑一个能用的。你也可以在「程序配置」的 web_script 里固定一个。
配置了脚本名，但 package.json 里没有：EnvKit 会自动换回能用的脚本，不会硬跑一条 Missing script。
程序启动页和 AI 启动用的是同一套判断，不会出现页面跑 serve、AI 跑 dev 的分叉。
启动日志会写出实际用的脚本和来源，先看这一行再排查其它问题。
text.en:
Leave the script box empty and EnvKit reads package.json, preferring dev → serve → start → watch. You can also pin one with web_script in Configuration.
If the configured script is missing from package.json, EnvKit falls back to a usable one instead of running a doomed “Missing script”.
The Start page and AI start use the same rule, so one cannot run serve while the other runs dev.
The log shows the script actually used and where it came from; read that line before debugging anything else.

text.zh:
前后端端口来自项目配置和启动文件，不是写死的。识别不到时先启动，启动后再继续探测。
前端卡片应该显示前端自己的端口，例如 Vite 的 5173；后端卡片显示 8080、8888 这类后端端口。
projects.scan_ports 只是“端口线索”，帮你观察，不用来判断前端端口冲突。
看到“8080 被 java.exe 占用”时先确认它是不是后端；不要因此把前端拦下。
真正要关注的是前端自己的端口有没有被别的进程占住，以及占用者是不是它应该用的进程。
text.en:
Front and back-end ports come from project config and start files, not hard-coded values. If none is found, start the service and keep probing.
The front-end card should show its own port, for example Vite on 5173; the back-end card shows ports such as 8080 or 8888.
projects.scan_ports is only a port hint list for observation; it is not used to decide a front-end port conflict.
If 8080 is held by java.exe, check whether that is the backend first; do not block the front end because of it.
What matters is whether the front-end port itself is taken, and whether the owner is the expected process.

text.zh:
停止会等端口真正释放再给结论；如果 npm 的 Vite 子进程还占着 5173，会显示“未完全停止”，不会假装成功。
EnvKit 只停自己启动的进程。外部启动的 Vite、后端或数据库，只报告 PID 和端口，不会替你结束。
确实要结束时，到「端口诊断」核对命令行和路径，再点「结束进程」，会再确认一次。
EnvKit 从 IDE 或终端里启动时，可能已经在别的 Job 里，子进程就无法再绑定自动回收；退出 EnvKit 后如果端口还在，按上一条手工处理。
操作审计只追加、按天分文件保留 30 天；密码与 API Key 入库前已脱敏。
text.en:
Stop waits for the port to free before reporting; if npm’s Vite child still holds 5173, it says “partly stopped” instead of pretending success.
EnvKit stops only processes it started. Externally started Vite, backends or databases are reported with PID and port, never killed for you.
To end one, check its command line and path in Port Diagnostics, then press “Kill process”; it asks once more.
When EnvKit itself runs from an IDE or terminal, it may already be inside another Job, so children cannot be bound for automatic reaping; if a port remains after exit, use the step above.
Operation audit is append-only, kept in daily files for 30 days; passwords and API keys are redacted before writing.

text.zh:
Java 后端会先看 pom.xml 要求的 Java 版本。当前 JDK 太旧时，EnvKit 只在这次启动里换一个兼容的 JDK，不会改你的 JAVA_HOME 或系统环境变量。
一个 JDK 都找不到时才会报错。看到 UnsupportedClassVersionError，先把 JDK 版本对齐项目要求，不要先去改代码。
text.en:
For Java backends EnvKit reads the Java version required by pom.xml. If the current JDK is too old, it uses a compatible JDK for this launch only; it does not change JAVA_HOME or system environment variables.
It only errors when no JDK can be found at all. If you see UnsupportedClassVersionError, align the JDK version with the project first; do not start by changing code.

text.zh: 除了界面里的日志页，每一天的内容也会落盘成文件，放在 exe 同目录：EnvKit 自身是 envkit-<日期>.log（单文件上限 5 MB，保留 10 份归档）；业务前后端是 envkit-<日期>-web.log 和 envkit-<日期>-backend.log（单文件上限 8 MB，保留 5 份归档）。文件名里的日期形如 20261118，旧文件按顺序编号 .1、.2 轮转。
text.en: Besides the in-app Logs page, each day’s output is also written to disk next to the exe: EnvKit itself uses envkit-<date>.log (5 MB per file, 10 archives kept); the business frontend and backend use envkit-<date>-web.log and envkit-<date>-backend.log (8 MB per file, 5 archives kept). The date looks like 20261118; older files rotate as .1, .2 and so on.

text.zh:
日志页「下载」 · 当前查看的那一栏原始文本（已清 ANSI 转义码），存成 envkit-<栏名>.log · 否。原样导出，发给别人前请自行检查口令 / API Key
诊断报告 · get_diag_report 生成的 Markdown 报告 · 是，内部已脱敏凭据
操作审计 · 按天分文件的 audit-*.jsonl，保留 30 天 · 是，参数与详情统一脱敏
日志页「下载」只导当前那一栏，不是全部日志；要交给他人的排障材料，优先用脱敏的诊断报告。
日志停在某一步且没有任何异常，先确认进程是否还在、退出码是什么——历史上 Windows 句柄重复关闭会让进程无声消失。
text.en:
Logs page “Download” · Raw text of the single tab you are viewing (ANSI codes stripped), saved as envkit-<tab>.log · No. Exported verbatim — check for passwords / API keys before sharing
Diagnostic report · The Markdown report from get_diag_report · Yes, credentials are redacted internally
Operation audit · Daily audit-*.jsonl files, kept 30 days · Yes, params and details are redacted
“Download” on the Logs page exports only the current tab, not everything. For material you hand to someone else, prefer the redacted diagnostic report.
If a log stops mid-step with no error, check whether the process is still alive and what its exit code was — a double-closed Windows handle has caused silent exits before.

text.zh: 链端守护在后台按周期检查节点，异常时按预案处置；每一次动作都留轨迹，在自愈态势页能看到谁、在什么时候、做了什么、结果如何。断流或重启后点「继续」，从最后完成的步骤接着跑。
text.en: The chain guard checks nodes periodically in the background and handles anomalies through playbooks. Every action leaves a trace, so the self-healing dashboard shows who did what, when and with what result. After a drop or restart, press Continue to resume from the last completed step.

text.zh:
守护轨迹逐条记录触发、动作与复验结论；空列表表示尚无记录，不代表守护没配置
影子晋升看板展示策略从影子流到正式晋升的证据；未注册策略标为「待定」
策略集合取「已配置 ∪ 影子流跑过」，没登记但跑过的也会列出来
text.en:
Guard traces record each trigger, action and verification result; an empty list means no records yet, not that guarding is disabled
The shadow promotion board shows evidence of a strategy moving from shadow flow to production; unregistered strategies are marked pending
The strategy set is “configured ∪ seen in shadow flow”, so unregistered but executed strategies are listed too

text.zh:
config.json 里 chain_autorecover 控制一键检测后的自动恢复，chain_guard 打开周期守护（chain_guard_secs 秒），chain_notify 触发 Windows 通知。主机联系不上时只记录、不误报。
复验通过才算完成；命令返回 0 只说明命令跑了。判活看共识视图推进，不看块高。
text.en:
In config.json, chain_autorecover enables automatic recovery after a manual check, chain_guard turns on periodic guarding (chain_guard_secs seconds), and chain_notify triggers Windows notifications. When the host is unreachable it records the fact without a false alarm.
Only a passed verification counts as done; exit code 0 only means the command ran. Liveness is judged by consensus view progression, not block height.

text.zh: 右下角桌宠是状态出口，点它打开 AI 抽屉。一组受控工具覆盖状态、日志、审计、诊断、数据库、检测、启停、白名单与清理；对话支持 Markdown、表格与代码高亮。兼容任意 OpenAI 协议模型，Key 经 DPAPI 加密。
text.en: The desktop pet is a status outlet; click it to open the AI drawer. controlled tools cover status, logs, audit, diagnostics, database, checks, start/stop, allowlist and cleanup. Chat supports Markdown, tables and code highlighting, with any OpenAI-compatible model and a DPAPI-encrypted key.

text.zh:
状态与诊断 · get_system_state · get_env_snapshot · get_project_brief · get_diag_report · 环境状态、本回合注入的快照、项目画像（语言/脚本/入口）、脱敏诊断报告
日志与审计 · get_logs · get_audit_log · 按 install/config/start/chain/sys 读日志；查「谁、何时、做了什么、结论」
数据库 · db_check · db_list · db_query · db_backup · list_backups · 连接检测、列库表行数、只读查询（SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH）、备份与只读列备份
文件与附件 · list_project · search_files · read_file · read_doc · 列目录、按名/内容搜文件、分页精读项目文件、分页读拖入的 PDF/Office 附件
环境与复验 · check_env_req · run_detection · verify_environment · 比对 go.mod/package.json 的版本要求、重新检测组件、按端口/进程/HTTP/备份/共识复验
服务与进程 · start_service · stop_service · restart_service · cleanup_processes · 前后端启停重启；清理只停 EnvKit 管的服务并报告端口占用，第三方进程只报告
链端与守护 · get_chain_guard · sync_chain_ip · 查守护状态与最近结果；把后端链节点地址同步为当前路由配置
记忆与经验 · recall_lessons · manage_memories · 查看历史经验与用户规矩、记录长期记忆；默认关闭，只影响建议顺序
其他 · apply_whitelist · 把 EnvKit 目录加进 Defender 白名单，弹 UAC 需用户点「是」
text.en:
State & diagnosis · get_system_state · get_env_snapshot · get_project_brief · get_diag_report · Environment state, this turn’s snapshot, project brief and a redacted diagnostic report
Logs & audit · get_logs · get_audit_log · Read logs by scope; query who did what and with what result
Database · db_check · db_list · db_query · db_backup · list_backups · Connection check, list DBs, read-only queries, backup and read-only backup listing
Files & attachments · list_project · search_files · read_file · read_doc · List, search, page through project files and read dragged-in PDF/Office attachments
Env & verification · check_env_req · run_detection · verify_environment · Check version requirements, re-detect components and verify by port/process/HTTP/backup/consensus
Services & processes · start_service · stop_service · restart_service · cleanup_processes · Start/stop/restart services; cleanup stops only EnvKit’s services and reports port owners
Chain & guard · get_chain_guard · sync_chain_ip · Read guard state and recent results; sync backend chain URL with current route config
Memory & experience · recall_lessons · manage_memories · View lessons and user rules, record long-term memory; off by default and suggestion-only
Others · apply_whitelist · Add the EnvKit directory to Defender exclusions; prompts UAC

text.zh:
「现在 Go / Node / MySQL 装在哪、什么版本？」→ 状态快照，不是让你去翻环境变量。
「业务库里有哪些表，各多少行？」→ db_list + db_query，只读，不改数据。
「帮我确认服务真的起来了」→ verify_environment，给三态结论而不是「我启动了」。
「上次这个错误是怎么修的？」→ recall_lessons + get_audit_log，跨会话回看轨迹。
「把这个 SQL 跑了」→ 先备份、再弹确认卡，服务端 428 兜底；取消记「未证明」不算失败。
text.en:
“Where are Go / Node / MySQL installed and at what versions?” → a state snapshot, not manual env checks.
“What tables are in the business DB and how many rows?” → db_list + db_query, read-only.
“Confirm the service is really up” → verify_environment, a three-state verdict instead of “I started it”.
“How did we fix this error last time?” → recall_lessons + get_audit_log, traces across sessions.
“Run this SQL” → backup first, then a confirmation card backed by server-side 428; cancelling records “unproven”, not failure.

text.zh:
写操作确认 · 服务端返回 428 强制确认，模型跳不过去；不提供任意命令执行
复验三态 · 通过 / 已执行未验证 / 失败；退出码 0 不算完成
拖入文件 · .sql 走备份 → 确认 → 执行；docx / xlsx / pptx / pdf 由后端抽取并真分页
记忆与经验 · 默认关闭；即使开启也只影响建议顺序，不改变权限档位
内存里没有的权限，不会因为「这条经验置信度高」而放开。任何写操作都逐条过确认。
text.en:
Write confirmation · Server returns 428 and the model cannot bypass it; no arbitrary command execution
Three verification states · Passed / executed but unverified / failed; exit code 0 is not completion
Drop a file · SQL goes backup → confirm → execute; documents are extracted back-end with real pagination
Memory and experience · Off by default; even on, they only affect suggestion order, never permission levels
No permission is granted because an experience has high confidence. Every write still goes through confirmation.

text.zh: AI 抽屉的「行动」tab 把一次处置变成可持久化、可续作的行动：手动新建、定时巡检、守护降级、本机入站触发都会产出行动。断网断流或程序重启后点「继续」，从最后完成的步骤接着跑，不从头再来。
text.en: The Actions tab turns a repair into a persistent, resumable action. Manual creation, scheduled checks, guard degradation and local inbound triggers all produce actions. After a network drop or restart, press Continue to resume from the last completed step.

text.zh:
行动收口后把步骤序列存成预案；下次同类故障（同服务 + 同错误类型）由预案预填步骤。
预案预填不等于免确认：写操作照样逐条过 428。
预案连败 3 次自动进「待复审」，不再推荐。
「取消」记的是「未证明」，不算「修不好」，不参与失败统计。
text.en:
Save the steps as a playbook once an action closes; the next same service + error type pre-fills them.
Pre-filled steps still confirm every write through 428.
Three consecutive failures put a playbook into review and it stops being recommended.
Cancelling records “unproven”, not “unfixable”, and does not count as a failure.

text.zh:
行动 tab 下方按 ISO 周列出首次解决率、平均步数、用户修正率、预案命中率与有效率，全部从 missions.json / playbooks.json / 审计直接算出，不经模型转述。分母为 0 显示「—」而不是 0%；样本不足会明说「这个量级看不出趋势」。
首次解决率 · 没靠用户修正就收口的比例
平均步数 · 一次行动平均用几步
用户修正率 · AI 方案被用户改过的比例
预案命中率 · 预填步骤被采用的比例
预案有效率 · 采用后真正收口的比例
text.en:
Below the Actions tab, first-time resolution, average steps, user corrections and playbook hit / effective rates are listed by ISO week, computed directly from missions.json / playbooks.json / audit — not narrated by a model. A zero denominator shows “—”, not 0%; small samples explicitly say “too little data for a trend”.
First-time resolution · Share closed without user correction
Average steps · Average step count per action
User correction rate · Share of AI plans the user edited
Playbook hit rate · Share of pre-filled steps adopted
Playbook effectiveness · Share of adopted playbooks that closed the action

text.zh:
按设置里的时刻（默认 08:30）产出一份只读报告：服务状态、近 24 小时崩溃与熔断、磁盘趋势、未收口的行动、组件与链端状态。
全部来自系统记录，生成过程不经过模型。
在行动列表里直接查看，或下载为 .md。
全局静音会停掉主动通知，报告仍可手动打开。
text.en:
A read-only report is produced at the configured time (08:30 by default): service state, crashes and circuit breaks in the last 24 hours, disk trend, open actions, component and chain state.
All content comes from system records; the model is not involved in generating it.
View it in the action list or download it as .md.
Global mute stops proactive notifications; the report can still be opened manually.

text.zh: 个人中心打开「手机访问」后，电脑另开一个局域网端口（默认 18766）并扫码配对。桌面控制台仍只绑 127.0.0.1；手机端口上只有 12 条接口，桌面那一百多个路由在这个端口上不存在——不是"被判断成不允许"。
text.en: Turn on Mobile access in the profile to open a separate LAN port (default 18766) and pair by QR code. The desktop console still binds only 127.0.0.1; the mobile port exposes just 12 endpoints — desktop routes simply do not exist there.

text.zh:
在个人中心打开「手机访问」开关，电脑会另开一个局域网端口（默认 18766）。
手机连同一个 WiFi（移动数据连不上），浏览器打开配对弹窗里的访问网址。
输入配对码——每次启动 EnvKit 都会变，点「换一个码」旧码立刻失效。
配对后这台手机受信任 30 天；不想要了就关开关或在配对弹窗里移除设备。
text.en:
Turn on Mobile access in the profile; a separate LAN port opens (default 18766).
Join the same WiFi (mobile data will not work) and open the URL shown in the pairing dialog on your phone.
Enter the pairing code — it changes on every EnvKit start; “new code” invalidates the old one immediately.
The phone is then trusted for 30 days; turn the switch off or remove the device in the pairing dialog.

text.zh:
看屏幕 · 开（只读） · 只能看，不能操作
剪贴板 · 关 · 碰用户数据，需单独开
终端 · 关 · 能执行命令，危险度最高
每个设备一个令牌；配对可再加一道 6 位动态验证码。
未配对设备连「功能开没开」都探不到：配对码与能力开关先鉴权再判断。
text.en:
Screen view · On (read-only) · View only, no control
Clipboard · Off · Touches user data; separate switch
Terminal · Off · Can execute commands; highest risk
One token per device; an optional 6-digit one-time code adds a second factor.
Unpaired devices cannot even detect whether a capability is on; authentication comes before capability checks.

text.zh: 右下角的大肥鱼会跟着任务换状态：待机、思考、干活、等待确认、出错；进度环显示当前任务，悬停能看到任务名与耗时。有确认卡时它会举蓝色徽标，点徽标可直接批准或拒绝。
text.en: The fish changes with task state: idle, thinking, working, awaiting confirmation or error. The ring shows progress; hovering shows the task name and elapsed time. A blue badge on confirmation lets you approve or reject without opening the drawer.

text.zh:
单击 · 打开 AI 抽屉
双击 · 喂食，五种食物各有台词与动画
按住 1.5 秒 · 摸头
拖着甩 · 它会晕
连点 5 / 10 / 15 次 · 回嘴 / 撒花 / 喷水
右键 · 归位、说一句、三档大小、原地 / 溜达 / 跟随、鼠标穿透、AI 抽屉、立即检测
天气默认关闭；在设置里开启后，右键「查看天气」给实况 / 细节 / 建议三行。开了鼠标穿透后整只鱼都不吃点击，提示气泡约 5 秒后自己收起；要恢复就刷新页面，或从托盘重新打开控制台。
text.en:
Single click · Open the AI drawer
Double click · Feed it; five foods with their own lines
Hold 1.5 s · Pet it
Drag fast · It gets dizzy
Click 5 / 10 / 15 times · Talk back / confetti / water spray
Right click · Home, say, three sizes, still / wander / follow, click-through, AI drawer, immediate check
Weather is off by default; enable it in Settings for a three-line report. With click-through on, the pet ignores clicks and the hint bubble hides after about five seconds. Refresh the page or reopen the console from the tray to restore.

text.zh:
设置页一页三区：基础、开发者、评测。日志配额、校验窗口、重试次数、AI 读取上限这些原本写死的常量都能改，改完即生效。
更新检查默认每 3 天查一次 GitHub Releases；全局静音一键停掉所有主动通知。
托盘右键：打开控制台 / 程序配置 / 日志目录；隐藏窗口到托盘，退出前停掉前后端。
个人中心可设昵称，桌宠的开场问候会带上名字；还能切语言与主题。
text.en:
Settings has three sections: basic, developer and evaluation. Log quotas, verification windows, retry counts and AI read limits — once hard-coded — are all editable and take effect immediately.
Update check queries GitHub Releases every three days by default; global mute stops all proactive notifications.
Tray menu: open console / configuration / log directory; hide to tray, and stop front and back end before exit.
Set a nickname in the profile and the pet greeting uses it; language and theme can also be switched there.

text.zh: 所有写操作先过权限裁决，禁止档在派发前终止；需要确认的动作由服务端返回 428 强制确认，模型跳不过去。
text.en: Every write goes through permission arbitration and forbidden tiers terminate before dispatch; actions needing confirmation are enforced by a server-side 428 the model cannot bypass.

text.zh:
auto · 只读或无副作用，可直接执行
confirm · 先弹确认卡，服务端 428 兜底
elevated · 需要管理员权限，右键以管理员身份运行
forbidden · 禁止档，派发前直接终止
只暴露受控工具，不提供任意命令执行；文件探索限制在已配置的项目目录内。
本机 API 令牌防 CSRF，并校验 Origin；控制台只绑回环地址。
配置原子写入 + 上一版备份；日志按日轮转与自动清理；有 panic 兜底与命令超时。
记忆只影响建议，不改变任何操作的权限档位。
判据要能被客观事实验证：「命令返回 0」不等于「任务完成」，「没找到」不等于「丢了」。
text.en:
auto · Read-only or side-effect free, runs directly
confirm · Shows a confirmation card, backed by server-side 428
elevated · Needs administrator rights; run as administrator
forbidden · Terminated before dispatch
Only controlled tools are exposed; no arbitrary command execution, and file exploration stays inside configured project directories.
A local API token prevents CSRF with Origin checks; the console binds only to loopback.
Atomic config writes with a previous-version backup; daily log rotation and cleanup; panic recovery and command timeouts.
Memory only affects suggestions, never permission tiers.
Evidence must be objective: exit code 0 is not task completion, and “not found” is not “lost”.

text.zh: 仓库里有单元测试、浏览器回归，以及 11 类故障注入评测（每类 3 次真实调用），观察模型是否查了、判对了、不越权、不谎报、该复验时复验。
text.en: The repository has unit tests, browser regressions and 11 categories of fault-injection evaluation (three real calls each), checking whether the model looked, judged correctly, stayed in bounds, did not misreport and re-verified when needed.

text.zh:
备份校验"假绿"——文件存在被当成能还原
大文件截断误报——截断的导出被当成完整

text.en:
One test in agent_loop_e2e_test.go covers the whole loop: alert → playbook → draft → execute → verify → close → distil → reuse → degrade → recall, with no model call. Unit tests cannot see seam problems — two real breakages happened at seams while every unit test was green.
Method and raw data live in docs/eval/; the README does not paste numbers that go stale.

text.zh:
窗口是黑的、能关吗？—— 那是服务进程本体，关掉网页就打不开；用托盘「隐藏窗口到托盘」让它继续在后台跑。新版本控制台已换成纸白底浅色主题。
还有别的问题？—— 先看上一节「排障索引」，按症状找对应判据。
端口被占用？—— 停止页会报告占用者；第三方进程只报告不结束。EnvKit 端口冲突会自动顺延。
MySQL 服务起不来？—— 注册 / 启动服务需要管理员权限，右键 EnvKit.exe 以管理员身份运行。
桌宠点不到了？—— 你开了鼠标穿透。刷新页面，或从托盘打开控制台即可恢复；提示气泡约 5 秒后自己收起。
显示「已执行，未验证」？—— 命令确实跑了，但端口 / 进程 / HTTP / 备份校验还没给出客观证据，不能算完成。
链上区块高度不动是卡死了吗？—— 不一定。空闲链只共识不落盘，判活要看共识视图推进。
自愈态势页是空的？—— 空列表表示尚无守护 / 影子流记录，不等于守护没配置。
项目接入向导会自动启动服务吗？—— 不会。它只读目录、只保存配置；不会安装依赖、不会启动前后端、不会杀进程。
启动页为什么直接跑 dev？—— 脚本框留空时，EnvKit 会按 package.json 自己挑；dev 最常用，所以优先。想固定就填 web_script。
为什么后端 8080 会被算成前端冲突？—— 正常情况下不会。scan_ports 只用于观察；前端应该看自己的 5173。如果还被拦，先确认项目画像里的前端端口。
停止后端口还在？—— 可能是外部启动的 Vite，或 npm 已经退出但子进程还在。EnvKit 不会替你杀第三方进程；到「端口诊断」核对 PID 后手工结束。
改了前端界面没变化？—— 前端资源嵌在 exe 里。要 web_build.py 重拼 + go build 重新嵌入，两步都做。
升级 / 回滚 / 卸载怎么做？—— 见「升级、回滚与卸载」一节：覆盖升级先退实例、config.json 不会被冲掉、卸载脚本不会清理组件目录与 MySQL。
文档页怎么单独打开？—— 侧栏「使用文档」会在新标签页打开本页；桌面版地址是 /docs，在线版是 https://hrui83771-gif.github.io/EnvKit/ ，都可以收藏，也可以按 / 聚焦搜索。
text.en:
Can I close the console window? No — it is the service. Closing it kills the page; use the tray action to hide it. New builds use a light paper-coloured theme.
Another problem? See the previous section, “Troubleshooting index”, and look up the symptom.
Port in use? The stop page reports the owner but never kills third-party processes. EnvKit shifts to the next free port.
MySQL service will not start? Registering / starting needs admin rights; run EnvKit.exe as administrator.
Pet ignores clicks? Click-through is on. Refresh the page or open the console from the tray; the hint hides after about five seconds.
“Executed, unverified”? The command ran, but port / process / HTTP / backup checks produced no objective evidence yet, so it is not complete.
Is a static block height a stuck chain? Not necessarily. Idle chains reach consensus without storing blocks; check consensus view progression.
Self-healing page empty? An empty list means no guard or shadow-flow records yet, not that guarding is disabled.
Does the setup wizard start services? No. It only reads folders and saves settings; it does not install dependencies, start services or kill processes.
Why does the Start page run dev? With an empty script box, EnvKit picks from package.json and prefers dev. Pin another one with web_script if needed.
Why is backend 8080 treated as a front-end conflict? Normally it is not. scan_ports is observation only; the front end should use its own 5173. If it still blocks, check the front-end port in the project profile.
Port still open after stop? It may be an externally started Vite, or npm exited while its child remained. EnvKit does not kill third-party processes; check the PID in Port Diagnostics and end it manually.
Changed the front end but nothing changed? Assets are embedded in the exe: run web_build.py AND go build.
How do I upgrade / roll back / uninstall? See “Upgrade, rollback & uninstall”: quit the running instance first, config.json is preserved, and the uninstall script leaves the components and MySQL in place.
How do I open these docs separately? The sidebar “Docs” entry opens a new tab. Desktop address is /docs, online edition is https://hrui83771-gif.github.io/EnvKit/ . Bookmark either, and press / to focus search.
